text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel wasn't feeling well, so I 
brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thank you very much♪ If you don't 
mind, I'll rest for just a little while.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Nn... Where is this...?

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Wait, Brian-chan!?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Queen Laurel. There's something I need 
to tell you.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"As commander of the Queen's Royal Guards, 
I have sworn my loyalty until now—yet, I 
can no longer suppress these feelings."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Laurel, with me—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Do a baguette-eating race...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: ...French bread?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"Someday, I wished... to have an all-out 
showdown with you."
Hooold on a secooond!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...Count Mayano, and Crown Prince 
Marvelous.

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Stealing a march like that is unfair! Maya 
wants to race against Laurel-san too!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Marvelouuus☆ French baguettes★ I won't 
lose~~☆★

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Step aside. I am the one who will face 
Laurel.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hehe! You all want to race with me, huh? 
In that case—

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Queen Laurel shall join you all in a 
French bread eating race...!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Taking all of us on at once, are you...? 
Heh, fascinating—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
*chomp, munch munch*...! All right, now 
all that's left is to cross the goal! Try 
and catch me if you can♪

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: —Huh? It was just a dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu♪ But it was a wonderful dream... I'd 
love to compete with everyone again.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel is back in top shape... It 
looks like she got plenty of rest!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then how about this☆ We'll decide who gets 
to face Laurel with a bean-jam bun eating 
race★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
"First come, first served~☆ Ready, set, 
go!★"

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: W-Wait, wait! If we're racing, I want to—!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Mmmgh... Just a dream, huh.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps due to the disappointing dream 
result, Sakura Laurel's poor condition 
remained unchanged...
